cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib, sys
z='decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip'
out='/tmp/jpegs'
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as f:
    for n in f.namelist():
        if n.endswith('.jpg'):
            p=os.path.join(out, os.path.basename(n))
            open(p,'wb').write(f.read(n))
            r=subprocess.run(['./libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x/fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x', p], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            print(os.path.basename(n), r.returncode)
            print(r.stdout.decode('latin1').splitlines()[-3:])
            break
